A loose crescent of about twenty-five strangers stands back from the box, phones raised; a few more arrive from either side and squeeze in at the back, people laugh and whisper to each other. Nobody steps closer to the box. Movement continues to the last frame. Sound: a growing murmur, traffic. No music.
